newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia CPI up 4.3 pct in first seven months.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia CPI up 4.3 pct in first seven months.

text.p: Tunisia's all-items consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.3 percent during the first seven months of 1996 compared to the same period in 1995, official figures show.
The year-on-year rise for the first seven months of 1995 was 6.1 percent.
The year-on-year rise for July this year was 3.9 percent compared with the year-on-year rise of 6.7 percent in July 1995.
The index was up by 0.8 percent in July compared to its level in June.
